review_notes: I read the whole file. The only definitions are `ContNormDet.algRK`, `algRE` and `algEquivK`. The rest are theorems, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. I checked Mathlib's `NumberField/InfiniteAdeleRing.lean`. There, `InfiniteAdeleRing` derives `CommRing, TopologicalSpace, IsTopologicalRing, Algebra K`, and there is no `Algebra ℝ` instance, `ℝ`-algebra equivalence with `mixedSpace`, or continuity or homeomorphism result for `ringEquiv_mixedSpace.symm`. A grep of the NumberField directory found no existing `Algebra ℝ (InfiniteAdeleRing …)`. So `algRK` and `algEquivK` have no Mathlib counterpart. `algRE` is built through `includeRight`, so it is not a competing version of a Mathlib concept either. The `solution` theorem repeats the same `letI` definitions inline instead of using `algRK`/`algRE`. That is repetition inside this file, not a competing Mathlib concept. I did not check other files in the repo for copies of these definitions, because the rubric concerns Mathlib. I found no justified finding.
